title.en: An Act Renaming the Loay Elementary School in the Municipality of Loay, Province of Bohol, to Senate President Pro Tempore Jose A. Clarin Memorial School

text.en: The Loay Elementary School located in the Municipality of Loay, Province of Bohol, is hereby renamed as the Senate President Pro Tempore Jose A. Clarin Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
